plugins.name: Custom Page
plugins.author: Nexus Labs
plugins.description: Experimental (BETA): build multiple custom sidebar pages with cards, buttons and interactive widgets.
plugins.configureHint: Experimental (BETA): open Custom Page Studio and create pages/cards/widgets from the Settings subpage.

info.title: Custom Page (BETA)
info.what: Experimental builder that creates a Settings subpage where you can make your own sidebar pages.
info.how: Create pages, then add cards and widgets like text boxes, selects, sliders, switches and action buttons.
info.usage: Enable plugin, open Custom Page Studio, create pages and build cards/widgets. Some parts can still be unstable.
notes: BETA: not all flows are final; behavior can change.
Button widgets can run Nexus actions.
All layout data is stored in plugin config.
